headline: Star Paper Mills receives order from GST Department for FY23-24
hook: GST penalty order hits paper mill
summary: Star Paper Mills has informed the stock exchanges that the GST Department has passed an order against the company for the financial year 2023-24. Details regarding the exact financial liability or penalty amount were not immediately disclosed in the initial filing. Regulatory actions of this nature can create short-term cash flow uncertainty for small-cap manufacturing companies. Retail investors should track subsequent disclosures for the financial impact on the company's earnings.
whats_next: Company disclosure on penalty amount and appeal details
why_it_matters: Tax disputes may create near-term cash outflows for Star Paper.
